RemediationStrings.Title: Print Spooler service is running
RemediationStrings.Description: The Print Spooler service is running on a device that must not print. This service is disabled for security reasons. Please contact the helpdesk.

RemediationStrings.Title: Print Spooler service is not disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: The Print Spooler service is allowed to start on this device. It must be set to Disabled for security reasons. Please contact the helpdesk.
